item: The terminal panel stays for the life of the app, in one window, with an activity log (R658)
summary: Field report 2026-11-11 (Debian and Windows): the panel disappeared after a click or after a while. Causes: a Close panel button, a Show log view that waited for Enter (a click never sends it), and a silence rule that closed the panel after 20 s (Windows, no pid, own window) or 5 min. Now no close button, the log view returns on any key, silence is shown not acted on, the server is watched by pid plus start time (psutil), an internal error redraws the panel with its log; the job list became an append-only activity log (newest LOG_KEEP=20000 lines in memory, scrollable); on Windows launch_server.ps1 runs the panel in the launcher's own console with the server pid, so one window.
